name: Becky and Grub line fixes
prompt: Change one line of {character}'s dialogue in {folder}.
If the line now is only part of a longer line, change only that part.
Keep the indent, the name and colon, and any #tags exactly as they are. In Yarn, a # { or } meant as text is written \# \{ \}.
If the line is in more than one place and the file or note doesn't say which, or you can't find it, change nothing and say why.
When done, say what you changed (file and line number).

checks.about: a # meant as text but not written \#

items.old: Number two, you're a whole thug.
items.new: Number two, you're a big thug.
It was a DIFFERENT shade of black.
